items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the rhythm section ended up being Sir Charles on piano, Vernon Alley on bass, and Irving Ashby... I did all the singing with Hamp's band

ctx.x: Anyway, they didn't join us, and so the rhythm section

ended up being Sir Charles on piano, Vernon Alley on bass, and Irving Ashby, he came from Boston -- and Hamp was getting people from just not Los Angeles; musicians he had heard while he was with Benny, and Ray Perry -- he got Ashby and Ray Perry from Boston. Ray Perry played alto and violin, and trombone player ... real good one; his name starts with a B; but I can't remember his name.

And he had at this time -- he had ... did Ernie join us at first? I don't know if Ernie Royal went with us at first or not, but anyway, Hamp left here with a pretty good band. Every time we started leaving home, it looked like I wouldn't stay too long, you know, so ... because I didn't really like to rough it. We went up in the Northwest, and, you know, Hamp was quite successful - but I did all the singing with Hamp's band, you know.
